description.value: You connect to your instincts as a weapon and the power of speed weapons, causing you to swing, stab, or shoot effortlessly. Make a Strike with yourself. For 1 minute, you're quickened, and you can use the extra action to make a Strike with yourself. If you're in inanimate mode or you're an item intelligent weapon, you don't make a Strike, and your wielder gains the quickened condition instead of you.
